fields.features_heading: What the Form Settles Before a Refund Goes Out
fields.features_subheading: A refund request form ties each request to an order and applies your own refund policy before anyone reads it.
fields.feature_1:
Every request matched to an order

The customer enters the order number and the email used at checkout. The app finds that order in your store's records through its API and fills in the item and its delivery date.
fields.feature_2:
Reasons you can count later

Offer a short list of reasons, such as damaged in transit or wrong size, with an Other box at the end. Ask for a photo only when the reason is damage. Other requests stay short.
fields.feature_3:
Your policy, run as rules

Each line of your refund policy becomes a check, such as the days allowed or the items you never refund. A request that misses a rule shows the customer why before it is sent.
fields.feature_4:
The refund method on the request

Let the customer pick the original payment method or store credit, where you offer both. The choice is saved with the request, and whoever issues the refund has nothing left to ask.
fields.feature_5:
Approvals set by the amount

Pick a dollar line above which a refund needs a named approver. That person gets an email or a Slack message with the request and the order, then opens it to approve or decline.
fields.feature_6:
Refunds you can read by reason

Each request is kept with its amount and decision in a database you own. A dashboard totals refunds by reason each month, and a reason that keeps rising points to its cause.

fields.tab_content_1:
Within 30 days, no one has to sign off

Saltmarsh Ceramics sells handmade mugs online, and its own policy refunds any order within 30 days of delivery. Wendell Ouko asks for a refund on 2 mugs at $38 each, $76 in all, 12 days after they arrive. The form finds his order and puts the request straight into the refund queue, with no manager review.
fields.tab_content_2:
The $240 plan refunds $180 after 3 months

Tallyroot sells scheduling software on a $240 annual plan, and its own policy refunds each unused full month at $20. Marisol Brandt cancels after 3 months. Before she submits, the form shows her refund: 9 unused months at $20, or $180, back to her original card.
fields.tab_content_3:
Inside 7 days, the class turns into an $85 credit

Copper Pot Cooking School runs evening classes at $85 a seat. Its own policy refunds a class canceled 7 or more days ahead and gives class credit inside 7 days. Jonah Petrakis cancels his pasta class 3 days before it starts. The form gives him an $85 credit toward any later class in place of a refund.
fields.tab_content_4:
Above $500, it is Teodora's call

Larkspur Cycles lets its floor staff approve refunds up to $500, and its policy sends any refund above $500 to the owner, Teodora Vance. Felix Okonjo asks for a $1,280 refund on an e-bike he brought back. The request reaches Teodora as an email with the order attached, and the refund waits until she approves it.

fields.howto_title: How to Create a Refund Request Form
fields.howto_description: Seven steps turn your written refund policy into a refund request form that checks each request and routes it, built with Emergent.
fields.howto_step_1_title: 01 Write your refund policy down as rules
fields.howto_step_2_title: 02 Pick the fields a request needs
fields.howto_step_3_title: 03 Name the refund methods you offer
fields.howto_step_4_title: 04 Set the amount staff can approve
fields.howto_step_1_des: Turn the policy into rules a form can check: the number of days allowed and the date the count starts from, such as delivery or purchase. List any items you never refund, such as gift cards or opened software.
fields.howto_step_2_des: Ask only for what ties a request to an order and explains it: the order number, the checkout email, a reason, and a photo for damage claims. Anything you would only need after approving it can wait.
fields.howto_step_3_des: Decide whether your policy pays back to the original payment method, gives store credit, or both, and which cases get which. A late cancellation might earn credit only, as at the cooking school above.
fields.howto_step_4_des: Choose the dollar limit staff can approve on their own and name the one person who decides above it. Pick a limit you would be comfortable seeing approved without a second look.
fields.howto_step_5_title: 05 Describe the form in one prompt
fields.howto_step_5_des: Write one prompt to Emergent that covers the fields, the refund rules, the refund methods, and the approval limit. Emergent builds the form with the database behind it, and you change any rule later by prompting.
fields.howto_step_6_des: Connect the store or billing tool that holds your orders through its API. The app looks up each order number and fills in the purchase date and amount, instead of asking the customer to type them.
fields.howto_step_7_title: 07 Test with past cases, then publish
fields.howto_step_7_des: Place four test requests from real past cases: one inside the window, one a day past it, one asking for store credit, and one above the approval limit. Check each result against your own decision, then publish on its own link or your custom domain (built into Emergent, uses credits).

faq_plan.q: What is a refund request form?
faq_plan.ref: What is a refund request form?

prov.original: What is a refund request form?

faq_plan.a: A refund request form is the form a customer fills in to ask a business for money back on an order, a booking, or a plan. It records what was bought and when, the reason, and how the customer wants to be paid back. The business then applies its own refund policy to that record.

faq_plan.q: How do I create a refund request form?
faq_plan.a: Write your refund policy as rules and decide who approves the larger refunds. Describe both in one prompt to Emergent's AI form builder, and it returns a working form that checks each request against those rules and records who approved it.

faq_plan.q: Which fields belong on a refund request form?
faq_plan.hint: Where do i send csrs refund request form?
faq_plan.a: Start with the order number and the checkout email, because together they tie the request to a real purchase. Add the item, a reason from a short list, the refund method the customer wants, and a photo upload that appears only for damage. Leave bank and card numbers off the form, and pay refunds back through the original payment method or as store credit.

faq_plan.q: Can a refund request form handle refunds for services instead of products?
faq_plan.hint: Who do i send the refund request form to gmu?
faq_plan.a: It works the same way once you swap the delivery date for the date of the service and ask for the booking or invoice number in place of an order number. If the customer wants the work redone rather than money back, point them to a service request form, which opens a job instead of a refund.

faq_plan.q: Should the reason be a required field on a refund request form?
faq_plan.a: Yes, make it required, but keep it to one quick choice. A dropdown with an Other box takes seconds, while a free-text box alone gives you answers you cannot count. In a form built with Emergent, you add or rename a reason by prompting, without rebuilding the form.

faq_plan.q: How does a refund request form check the refund window?
faq_plan.a: It counts the days from the start date your policy names to the date of the request, then compares that count with your limit. Say on the form whether you count calendar days or business days. A customer on day 31 of a 30-day window then knows why the request went to review.

faq_plan.q: Can one app run a refund request form alongside other request forms?
faq_plan.a: The app Emergent builds can hold several request forms side by side, each with its own fields and approvers. Give anything sensitive a separate form and approver: an HR team that takes a reasonable accommodation request form should keep those records away from the staff who handle refunds.

faq_plan.q: How can a refund request form keep customers updated on their status?
faq_plan.a: Send an email each time the status changes, such as received, approved, refunded, or declined. Link that email to a page that shows where the request stands and what happens next. When Emergent builds the form, the app sends those emails as each status change is saved.

faq_plan.q: Should a refund request form offer store credit instead of a refund?
faq_plan.a: Offer store credit as a choice next to money back, unless your own policy gives credit only in certain cases. Where it does, such as a late cancellation, show that rule on the form before the customer submits. The form then records which method each customer chose.

faq_plan.q: Who reviews refund request form submissions when the usual approver is away?
faq_plan.a: A backup approver you name ahead of time, for each approval limit. If people already book leave through a time off request form, the app can read those dates and send requests to the backup until the main approver returns.

plan.angle: The top 10 splits between issuer refund portals and agency PDFs (software vendors, the USPTO, WIPO, a state revenue office) and template galleries that stop at a blank list of fields. None of them shows a merchant how to turn its own refund policy into a form that applies it. This page does: the request is checked against the business's own window, priced against what was used, offered credit where the policy says credit, and sent to the right approver by amount. Four businesses show one rule each, and every rule is framed as that business's own policy, never as a consumer right.
